tools.name: eks_find_terraform
tools.description: Extract declared EKS versions from a Terraform root: cluster version, add-ons, node groups, Helm charts (resources and module-wrapped), AMI SSM parameters pinned to a Kubernetes minor, and warnings for node group versions the module never sets, silently dropped inputs and unpinned charts. Returns JSON with file:line locations.

params.name: root_dir
params.description: Terraform root directory to scan for .tf files
